propositions: The codebase carries two semantically identical headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for the same concept, but applies a single bar across both; the split is vestigial vocabulary not reflected in gate logic

Success Criteria items are conventionally written as plain bullets and do not count toward the P1 blocking floor, cannot carry operator attestation tags, and are not individually checkable, while Acceptance Criteria items are checkboxes counted by _count_ac_items

Collapsing Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, author guides, generated guides, eval specs, test corpus, and 108+ store tickets will tighten the gate and unify the vocabulary

Store migration must migrate all Success Criteria headings and plain-bullet items to Acceptance Criteria with checkbox format, keeping prose mentions of the term intact and ensuring zero SC headings remain

Three permanent carve-outs must survive the migration: plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics English), plan_review_verifier.md and verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable wording), and llm/completion.py:288 (heading-sense vocabulary in completion logic)

Grep verification and regenerated criteria guide must confirm only the four excluded sites and vendor bundle retain SC vocabulary, with exactly one match in the generated guide (the T2 criterion's embedded prompt)
